title: Florida House, District 17
what_it_does: Represents District 17 (Part of Duval) in the Florida House; votes on state laws and the state budget.
verified_ballot_note: Candidate list taken from the Florida Division of Elections, 2026 general election candidate list on 2026-09-18 (https://dos.elections.myflorida.com/candidates/CanList.asp); statuses Qualified/Unopposed only. Counties from the Legislature's district listings. Positions have not been researched yet.

candidates.name: Jessica Baker
candidates.photo_source: Ballotpedia candidate photo (downloaded copy in assets/photos)
candidates.background: Jessica Baker is a Jacksonville attorney first elected to the House in 2022. Her campaign highlights a 2024 tax-cut package (HB 7073), teacher-pay funding and child-protection legislation, and she sponsored the Officer Jason Raynor Act, which became law in 2026.

roster_sources.title: Florida Division of Elections, 2026 general election candidate list

property_tax.summary: Baker voted for HJR 203 and HJR 1-F in 2026.

sources.title: Florida House roll call, CS/HJR 1-F (2026 special session), passage 75-26
Florida House roll call, CS/CS/HJR 203 (2026), passage 80-30

immigration.summary: Baker voted for SB 2-C, the 2025 state immigration-enforcement package.

sources.title: Florida House roll call, SB 2-C (2025 special session, immigration), passage 85-30

abortion.summary: Baker voted for SB 300, the 2023 six-week abortion law.

sources.title: Florida House roll call, SB 300 (2023 six-week abortion law), passage 70-40

guns.summary: She voted for permitless carry in 2023 and for lowering the long-gun purchase age in 2025 and 2026.

sources.title: Florida House roll call, CS/HB 543 (2023 permitless carry), passage 76-32
Florida House roll call, HB 759 (2025, lower long-gun purchase age to 18), passage 78-34
Florida House roll call, HB 133 (2026, lower long-gun purchase age to 18), passage 74-37

education_choice.summary: Baker voted for HB 1, the 2023 universal school-choice expansion.

sources.title: Florida House roll call, CS/CS/CS/CS/HB 1 (2023 universal school choice), passage 83-27

crime.summary: She was House sponsor of the Officer Jason Raynor Act (SB 156, 2026), mandating life without parole for killing a police officer, and touts child-protection legislation.

sources.title: The Floridian: DeSantis Signs Jason Raynor Act, Several Public Safety Bills Into Law
Jessica Baker campaign website
